<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, goodwill was
$<span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--Goodwill_iI_c20251231_ziyWi5qjJpf7"><span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--Goodwill_iI_c20241231_z2fXHYNTy6t5">0</span></span>, respectively. For the year ended December 31, 2024, the Company
recorded a $<span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--GoodwillImpairmentLossNetOfTax_c20240101__20241231_zKQn8gPOxCW6" title="Impairment loss">1,567,485</span> impairment
loss on the balance of goodwill. See &#8220;<i>Note 3 &#8211; Significant Accounting Policies</i>&#8221; for managements position on
impairment of long-lived assets.</p>
